products.body: Cast a ward of protection on your treasured D&D sourcebooks with the Premium Book Cover for Dungeons & Dragons. The Sage Green and Brown textured leatherette cover features a rigid layer of protection for both the front and back of the book while remaining flexible at the binding for ease of use. Simply slip the back cover into the soft grey suede interior back pocket and use the front elastic strap to either hold the front cover open or secure the book closed by pulling it over the back cover. Admire the custom Deven Rue map of the Forgotten Realms in the sumptuous interior. This Premium Book Cover pairs beautifully with the entire Artifacts Across Eternities – Drizzt & The Forgotten Realms line of Ultra PRO premium accessories for Dungeons & Dragons. Sized for both vintage and current size books, this is the ultimate upgrade for any party member, DM, or D&D enthusiast!
